learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the ancient magic of Yoga to build a super flexible body, calm your mind, and unlock the hidden power of your breathing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Asanas are physical postures that stretch and strengthen your muscles. Poses like the Cobra or the Downward Dog make your spine flexible and keep your body free from aches and pains!
Pranayama is the science of breath control. By taking deep, slow, and focused breaths, you can instantly calm your nervous system and send extra oxygen to fuel your busy brain.
This is a wonderful continuous flow of 12 powerful yoga poses performed together. It acts as a full-body workout that warms up your muscles, improves digestion, and boosts your morning energy levels.
Yoga is not just for the body, it is a gym for your mind too! Sitting quietly and focusing your thoughts helps wash away exam stress, making you feel happier and more peaceful.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Tree Pose Balance Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Stand tall, bend one knee, and place the sole of your foot on your opposite inner thigh. Put your hands together like a namaste and see if you can hold this Tree Pose (Vrikshasana) for 30 seconds without wobbling!

quick_recap: ⭐ Yoga perfectly connects your mind and body through physical poses (Asanas) and breathing exercises (Pranayama).
⭐ Practicing yoga every day improves your flexibility, builds core strength, and gives you a laser-sharp focus for your studies.
